create_reward_config: create a RewardConfig instance to configure training parameters for the RewardTrainer
build_reward_training_args: build command-line training arguments from RewardConfig using HfArgumentParser for RewardTrainer
configure_reward_model_init: configure model initialization kwargs for RewardTrainer including MoE output_router_logits support
set_reward_data_preprocessing: set reward data preprocessing parameters like max_length, eos_token, and dataset_num_proc
configure_reward_training: configure reward training parameters including center_rewards_coefficient and activation_offloading
